doc-001: The city council approved a six-month trial of a cycle lane on Market Street by 7 votes to 4, despite shop owners' concerns about losing 40 parking spaces. Supporters cited a 25% rise in commuter cycling.
doc-002: The author has had trouble sleeping for several weeks because of work deadlines. Cutting out afternoon coffee helped slightly, and they plan to discuss their workload with their manager.
doc-003: A five-year study of 1,200 adults found that walking 30 minutes a day was linked to a 6 mmHg reduction in systolic blood pressure, especially in people over 60. As an observational study, it cannot prove causation.
